mcqs.question: Who were appointed Chair and Co-Chair, respectively, of the SEBI Expert Working Group on debenture trustees?
options: Tuhin Kanta Pandey and Ashok Kumar Lahiri
mcqs.explanation: Ananta Barua was appointed Chair and Rajnish Kumar Co-Chair of the SEBI Expert Working Group on debenture trustees. The reverse pairing of Rajnish Kumar and Ananta Barua is the most plausible trap, but their designated positions were Chair and Co-Chair respectively.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed High Commissioner to Malaysia in July 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Somnath Ghosh was appointed High Commissioner to Malaysia. Koppula Srikar Reddy and Anjani Kumar were appointed to ambassadorial posts in Qatar and Ukraine respectively, while Vikram Misri’s appointment concerned the Foreign Secretary’s term.

mcqs.question: Who succeeded Sanjay Kumar Jain as Additional CMD of IRCTC from July 20, 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Rahul Himalayan succeeded Sanjay Kumar Jain as Additional CMD of IRCTC from July 20, 2026. Bijay Kumar Mohanty was associated with the additional charge of CMD, IREDA, not IRCTC.

mcqs.question: Up to which date was Vikram Misri’s term as Foreign Secretary extended?
mcqs.explanation: Vikram Misri’s term as Foreign Secretary was extended up to July 14, 2027. December 31, 2026 was the extended term mentioned for the CBDT Chairman, while March 31, 2027 relates to the retirement of Alok Sharma.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology?
mcqs.explanation: Prof. Umesh Waghmare was appointed Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology. Ravi Shankar became Executive Director of the RBI, whereas Anurag Jain and Naresh Pal Gangwar held appointments in NITI Aayog and Higher Education respectively.

mcqs.question: Who took charge as Executive Director of the RBI from July 1, 2026, while continuing to oversee the Statistics and Information Management Department?
mcqs.explanation: Ravi Shankar became Executive Director of the RBI from July 1, 2026 and continued to oversee the Statistics and Information Management Department. Sanjay Malhotra was identified as the RBI Governor, not the newly appointed Executive Director.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed Part-time Chairman of HDFC Bank for three years from June 30, 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Rajiv Kumar, the former Chief Election Commissioner, was appointed Part-time Chairman of HDFC Bank for three years from June 30, 2026. Sashidhar Jagdishan was identified as HDFC Bank’s Managing Director, not its newly appointed Part-time Chairman.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed CMD of Hindustan Shipyard Ltd, Visakhapatnam?
mcqs.explanation: Rear Adm. C. Raghuram (Retd) was appointed CMD of Hindustan Shipyard Ltd, Visakhapatnam. Capt. Ganti Venkateswarulu had held additional charge since January 2026 and was succeeded by Rear Adm. C. Raghuram.

mcqs.question: Who became the first woman Army officer appointed as ADC to the President?
mcqs.explanation: Major Navya Shekhawat became the first woman Army officer appointed as ADC to the President. The other named officers in the options were associated with different appointments or background details; the repeated option is not used as a separate choice in the intended answer set.

mcqs.question:
Match the persons in List-I with the associated appointment or service detail in List-II.

List-I
 a. Amit Garg
 b. Amit Kumar
 c. Director, NCRB
 d. Next SPG chief

List-II
 i. 1993 IPS, Andhra Pradesh cadre
 ii. 1994 IPS, Bihar
 iii. Amit Garg
 iv. Amit Kumar
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairing is Amit Garg—1993 IPS, Andhra Pradesh cadre; Amit Kumar—1994 IPS, Bihar; Director, NCRB—Amit Garg; and Next SPG chief—Amit Kumar. The key distinction is between Amit Garg’s NCRB appointment and Amit Kumar’s succession as SPG chief.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the National Testing Agency and the task force on its reforms, consider the following statements:
1. NTA conducts NEET (UG), JEE Main and CUET.
2. NTA was established in 2019.
3. The task force included S. Somanath and Tapan Deka.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct: NTA conducts NEET (UG), JEE Main and CUET, and the task force included S. Somanath and Tapan Deka. Statement 2 is incorrect because NTA was established in 2018, not 2019.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The ITU AI for Good Global Commission is co-chaired by Paul Kagame and Marc Benioff.
Reason (R): Its first meeting was held in Zurich from July 7–10, 2026.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true: Paul Kagame and Marc Benioff co-chaired the Commission. Reason R is false because its first meeting was scheduled in Geneva from July 7–10, 2026, not Zurich; in any case, the meeting venue would not explain the co-chairmanship.

mcqs.question:
Match the institutions or offices in List-I with the associated person or detail in List-II.

List-I

 b. NITI Aayog
 c. RBI
 d. Ministry of External Affairs

List-II
 i. Statutory body established in 1992
 ii. Vice-Chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri

mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are SEBI—statutory body established in 1992; NITI Aayog—Ashok Kumar Lahiri; RBI—Sanjay Malhotra; and Ministry of External Affairs—S. Jaishankar. The alternative codes interchange the heads or assign the statutory detail to the wrong institution.

mcqs.keyword: Establishment year and status of organisations
mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about organisations mentioned in the appointments news are correct?
1. IRCTC was established in 1999 and is a Navratna.
2. Hindustan Shipyard Ltd was established in 1948.
3. NCRB was established in 1985.
4. SPG was established in 1986.
mcqs.explanation: Only one statement is correct: IRCTC was established in 1999 and is a Navratna. Hindustan Shipyard Ltd was established in 1941, NCRB in 1986 and SPG in 1985, making statements 2, 3 and 4 incorrect.

mcqs.explanation: IGNFA is located in Dehradun and was established in 1987; Dr. Rajendra Prasad Khajuria is a 1991 IFS officer of the Andhra Pradesh cadre, succeeding Bharati. The other codes mismatch the institution’s location, year or appointment details.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The President has four ADCs, comprising three Army officers and one Navy officer.
Statement B: Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani is the Emir of Kuwait.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. The President has five ADCs—three from the Army, one from the Navy and one from the Air Force—and Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani is the Emir of Qatar, not Kuwait.

mcqs.question:
Match the persons in List-I with the associated appointment or event in List-II.

List-I
 a. Ravi Agarwal
 b. Bijay Kumar Mohanty
 c. Kanishka Narayan
 d. R. T. Nagrani

List-II
 i. CBDT Chairman’s term extended to December 31, 2026
 ii. Additional charge as CMD, IREDA from July 1, 2026 for three months
 iii. Appointed by PM Andy Burnham
 iv. Led Operation Black Thunder
mcqs.explanation: Ravi Agarwal’s CBDT tenure was extended to December 31, 2026; Bijay Kumar Mohanty received additional charge as CMD of IREDA; Kanishka Narayan was appointed by PM Andy Burnham; and R. T. Nagrani led Operation Black Thunder. Therefore, the correct code is a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
